interpretation: Five development and five new static validation views in the same simulator room. Optical-Z truth is evaluation-only. Coverage is not classification accuracy; valid-pixel MAE and common-pixel MAE are reported. Real-camera and RK3588 performance are unverified.

replacement_study.selection: Freeze on views 1-5: improve coverage, <=0.1m coverage, MAE/p95/common MAE; limit extra out-of-range false predictions to 0.5% of image pixels; then maximize <=0.1m truth coverage.

confidence.metric: LR optical-Z difference <=min(0.1m, 5% of predicted Z)
confidence.fusion: Accepted primary prediction takes priority; accepted gamma fallback otherwise; keep source identity.
